content: For training of TCEN, we set $\alpha _{asr}=0.2$ and $\alpha _{mt}=0.8$ in the pre-training stage, since the MT dataset is much larger than ASR dataset. For fine-tune, we use $\alpha _{st}=0.6, \alpha _{asr}=0.2$ and $\alpha _{mt}=0.2$, same as the `many-to-many' baseline.
